title: Step 5c - Analyzing Customer Segments: Insights from K-means Clustering

cues.en: Instructor: And now we're basically done with the 2D plot.
cues.zh: 講師：現在二維圖基本上完成了。

cues.en: All there is left to do here is just to add a nice title, a nice label to the x-axis, a nice label to the y-axis, and then just show it.
cues.zh: 剩下只要加上好看的標題、X 軸標籤、Y 軸標籤，再把它顯示出來。

cues.en: So we're gonna do this now.
cues.zh: 現在就來做。

cues.en: We're gonna do this efficiently.
cues.zh: 我們有效率地完成。

cues.en: Well, you know, I have an idea, we can actually take what we did here so that we don't have to retype everything again, and we'll just change the input.
cues.zh: 我有個想法，可以直接取用這裡做過的內容，不用全部重打，只要更改輸入就好。

cues.en: So there we go. I'm going to paste that right here.
cues.zh: 來吧，我把它貼到這裡。

cues.en: So let's see, for the title, we're gonna choose, well, let's say, Clusters of customers.
cues.zh: 標題就選「顧客群組」。

cues.en: Right? Then for the xlabel, well, we're gonna choose Annual Income, right?
cues.zh: 對吧？xlabel 就選「年收入」。

cues.en: Because remember that the x-coordinates correspond to the first column here, Annual Income, and the y-coordinate will be the Spending Score.
cues.zh: 因為記得 X 座標對應第一欄年收入，Y 座標則是消費分數。

cues.en: So Annual Income here, and we can specify that it is indeed in k$, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡填年收入，也可以標明單位是千美元，好嗎？

cues.en: Good. And then for the ylabel now, as we just said, it is the Spending Score.
cues.zh: 很好，ylabel 剛才說過，是消費分數。

cues.en: And we can specify the scale from 1 to 100.
cues.zh: 可以標示尺度從 1 到 100。

cues.en: Perfect. And finally plt dot show.
cues.zh: 很好，最後是 plt.show。

cues.en: So there you go, my friends.
cues.zh: 好了，朋友們。

cues.en: We are ready to visualize the clusters.
cues.zh: 準備好把群組視覺化了。

cues.en: So let's hope I didn't make any mistake.
cues.zh: 希望我沒有出錯。

cues.en: And let's play the cell in order to, yes, perfect, in order to visualize the clusters.
cues.zh: 執行這個儲存格，對，很好，顯示各個群組。

cues.en: So we can clearly see that we have five clusters of customers.
cues.zh: 可以清楚看到有五個顧客群組。

cues.en: And so now let's analyze them in order to understand what they are, because I remind that the goal of doing this, you know, the goal for the model to do clustering here,
cues.zh: 接著分析並了解它們，因為提醒一下，這裡讓模型進行分群的目標，

cues.en: is to understand better their customers.
cues.zh: 是更深入了解顧客。

cues.en: You know, it's to extract some insights from their customers in order to, you know, boost the business by making some offers, you know, some relevant offers to the different clusters of customers
cues.zh: 從顧客資料中取得洞見，針對不同的顧客群組提供適合的優惠，來促進業務，

cues.en: that are in this group.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡的不同群組。

cues.en: Okay? So let's see.
cues.zh: 好，我們來看看。

cues.en: Let's start with this cluster which should correspond to the color sign, which therefore is cluster 4.
cues.zh: 先從這個青色群組開始，也就是第四群。

cues.en: Actually, I have an idea.
cues.zh: 其實我有個想法。

cues.en: We can actually add the legend.
cues.zh: 可以加上圖例。

cues.en: And the trick to do that is to call the legend function by, still, matplotlib.
cues.zh: 做法是一樣從 Matplotlib 呼叫 legend 函式。

cues.en: See, if we play this now, we will get the legend.
cues.zh: 你看，現在執行就會得到圖例。

cues.en: See, that's easier for us now.
cues.zh: 這樣就方便多了。

cues.en: So indeed, as we just said, this cluster of color sign corresponds to cluster number four.
cues.zh: 正如剛才所說，青色群組對應第四群。

cues.en: And what is it characterized by?
cues.zh: 它有什麼特徵呢？

cues.en: Well, this cluster basically contains all the customers that have a low annual income and who spends very few in the mall.
cues.zh: 這個群組基本上包含所有年收入低，而且在購物中心消費很少的顧客。

cues.en: All right? So that's the first cluster.
cues.zh: 好，這是第一個分析的群組。

cues.en: Then this cluster here corresponds to cluster number five and contains all the customers who earn a high annual income, but still, who don't spend much in the mall.
cues.zh: 這裡是第五群，包含所有年收入高，但在購物中心仍然消費不多的顧客。

cues.en: Then this cluster, cluster number one, is the cluster of the customers who earn a low annual income and yet have a high spending score.
cues.zh: 這個第一群，則是年收入低，消費分數卻很高的顧客。

cues.en: All right, so interesting.
cues.zh: 好，很有意思。

cues.en: I'll make my comments afterwards on how to leverage these clusters and, you know, boost the business, maybe.
cues.zh: 稍後我會說明如何運用這些群組，或許可以促進業務。

cues.en: So that we go. Let's continue.
cues.zh: 我們繼續。

cues.en: This cluster corresponds to cluster number three and contains all the customers that earn a high annual income and also who spend a lot in the mall.
cues.zh: 這裡是第三群，包含年收入高，而且在購物中心消費很多的顧客。

cues.en: And finally, there is this cluster which is like an average cluster and contains customers that earn an average annual income and spend normally in the mall.
cues.zh: 最後這群比較平均，包含年收入中等，而且在購物中心消費也普通的顧客。

cues.en: Okay, so interesting.
cues.zh: 好，很有意思。

cues.en: We have these different clusters of customers.
cues.zh: 我們有這些不同的顧客群組。

cues.en: And so now, you know, some business strategies or business IDs or, you know, marketing IDs would be, for example, to target better our customers.
cues.zh: 現在可以提出商業策略、業務想法或行銷構想，例如更精準地鎖定顧客。

cues.en: For example, these customers here who belong to cluster three and are characterized by a high annual income and a high spending score, well, to these customers,
cues.zh: 像這裡屬於第三群、年收入高且消費分數也高的顧客，針對這些人，

cues.en: we could totally target them the most when there are some new offers, you know, some new deals.
cues.zh: 每當有新優惠、新促銷時，完全可以優先鎖定他們。

cues.en: Because indeed, these are with these customers that you'll get the highest chance to sell your products, right?
cues.zh: 因為對這些顧客，你賣出產品的機會最高，對吧？

cues.en: Because they spend a lot, and besides, they have a high annual income, therefore, a high potential to buy a lot of stuff.
cues.zh: 他們花得很多，而且年收入高，所以購買許多商品的潛力也很高。

cues.en: But then, you know, as a mall, you are responsible, and you have some ethics.
cues.zh: 但身為購物中心，也應該負責任，具備一些道德原則。

cues.en: Well, for these customers, who seem to earn a low annual income, but yet, seem to have a problem spending too much maybe in the mall, well, maybe that the mall would like to be responsible
cues.zh: 對於這些年收入似乎不高，卻可能在購物中心消費過度的顧客，購物中心也許應該負起責任，

cues.en: and protect these customers by not targeting them too much with new deals and new irresistible offers that, after all, maybe these customers don't need at the end of the day.
cues.zh: 保護他們，不要過度向他們推銷新促銷或難以抗拒的優惠，畢竟這些顧客可能根本不需要。

cues.en: So yes, if there is some social responsibility or some ethics in the mall.
cues.zh: 所以，如果購物中心具有社會責任感與道德原則，

cues.en: Well, they would limit perhaps the targeting to these customers, you know, the advertising and all the digital marketing deployed to these customers, right?
cues.zh: 或許就會限制對這些顧客的廣告投放，以及各種數位行銷，對吧？

cues.en: So that's another insight we could get or another new action item in the strategy, which aims to indeed boost the business, but at the same time, be socially responsible.
cues.zh: 這是我們能得到的另一個洞見，也可以成為策略中的新行動項目，目的是促進業務，同時承擔社會責任。

cues.en: Then what can we do with this clusters?
cues.zh: 那這個群組可以怎麼處理？

cues.en: Well, same, you know, low annual income and low spending score.
cues.zh: 一樣，年收入低，消費分數也低。

cues.en: Well, if I was in the board of the mall, I would actually not do anything with this cluster.
cues.zh: 如果我是購物中心的董事，對這群人其實不會採取什麼行動。

cues.en: Because, you know, we don't really have to protect them, because they don't spend much.
cues.zh: 因為他們消費不多，不太需要特別保護。

cues.en: And besides, they have a low income, so we don't want to target them too much.
cues.zh: 而且收入低，也不想過度鎖定他們。

cues.en: What about this one now?
cues.zh: 那這一群呢？

cues.en: A high annual income and a low spending score.
cues.zh: 年收入高，消費分數低。

cues.en: Well, that's another cluster that would be interesting to target, right?
cues.zh: 這又是很值得鎖定的群組，對吧？

cues.en: Because maybe we are missing out on a lot of customers who don't seem to take much action in the mall here.
cues.zh: 因為我們可能錯失了很多顧客，他們目前似乎不常在購物中心購物。

cues.en: So maybe, you know, for this clusters, we could brainstorm on how to send them some better advertising that attract them more and track them better into the mall
cues.zh: 對這群人，或許可以腦力激盪，想想怎麼提供更好的廣告，更能吸引他們，讓他們更願意來購物中心，

cues.en: so that they can purchase more products and increase their spending score.
cues.zh: 購買更多產品，提高消費分數。

cues.en: So that's what I would do with this cluster.
cues.zh: 我會對這個群組採取這種做法。

cues.en: I would try to improve the advertising so that they can become more loyal customers who spend more in the mall.
cues.zh: 試著改善廣告，讓他們成為更忠誠、在購物中心消費更多的顧客。

cues.en: And finally, well, this cluster.
cues.zh: 最後是這個群組。

cues.en: Again, not much we could do, because, at the same time, we would like to target them, but not too much, because we don't want to target the ones that have a low annual income.
cues.zh: 一樣，能做的不多，因為雖然想鎖定他們，但不能過度；我們不想過度鎖定年收入低的人。

cues.en: So we want to protect them at the same time.
cues.zh: 同時也要保護他們。

cues.en: And there you go. I wouldn't do too much here.
cues.zh: 就是這樣，我在這裡不會做太多。

cues.en: But you see that's exactly the purpose of doing clustering.
cues.zh: 但你看，這正是分群的目的。

cues.en: We identified some different clusters of customers.
cues.zh: 我們辨識出了幾個不同的顧客群組。

cues.en: And for each of them, we can deploy different marketing strategies or different business strategies, which will boost the customers in some of the clusters and will protect them in other clusters.
cues.zh: 對每個群組都能採取不同的行銷或商業策略，在某些群組促進消費，在其他群組保護顧客。

cues.en: You see, you see the point?
cues.zh: 你懂這個重點嗎？

cues.en: That's exactly the kind of insights that you can get from clustering.
cues.zh: 這正是分群能提供的洞見。

cues.en: All right, so I hope you enjoyed this practical activity.
cues.zh: 好，希望你喜歡這次實作活動。

cues.en: And now my friends, we're gonna move on to next section to implement, this time, another type of clustering model, which is hierarchical clustering.
cues.zh: 朋友們，接著進入下一個單元，實作另一種分群模型，也就是階層式分群。

cues.en: I can't wait to see you soon in a new section.
cues.zh: 期待很快在新單元再見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
